title: Jissen! Pachi-Slot Hisshou-hou! 3
native_title: 実戦！ パチスロ必勝法！３
overview:
Play from any viewpoint you like with polygon graphics!

Winning Point
Use this to grasp which halls suit you based on your occupation, playing time of day, hall location conditions and more. Learn the mechanics of "when they pay out" and "when they don't" as seen from the hall operator's side!

Three modes that make the ultimate analysis possible
- Explanation: acquire knowledge
- Strategy: analyze the machines
- Live Play: analyze the hall

ポリゴン画像により好きな視点でプレイ可能!

必勝POINT
プレイヤーの職業別に、プレイ時間帯、ホールの立地条件等の向き不向きをこれで把握。ホール経営者側から見た"出すとき""出さないとき"の仕組みを知れ!

究極の解析を可能とした3モード
解説 知識を習得
攻略 台を解析
実戦 ホールを分析
